title: Bedrock shafts along the causeway as industrial infrastructure
summary: Jeffrey tells of Bedrock shafts along the causeway as industrial infrastructure, about ancient at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, in in my opinion, that's part of the industrial infrastructure of the Giza Plateau.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about shafts cut into the bedrock along the causeway, a long ancient road on Egypt's Giza Plateau that leads to the pyramid of the pharaoh Khafre. In his opinion these shafts are part of the industrial infrastructure of the Giza Plateau. If true, it would mean the pyramid site was a working industrial complex and not only a set of tombs.
